title: 0DTEs: Trading, Gamma Risk and Volatility Propagation
one_line: No evidence that 0DTE gamma raises S&P volatility: higher 0DTE and short-dated open-interest gamma goes with LOWER intraday realized volatility, does not carry overnight, and 0DTE volume shocks have only tiny, short-lived effects; 0DTEs carry the largest volatility risk premium.

findings.statement: Higher 0DTE open-interest gamma → lower same-day realized volatility.
0DTE volume shocks raise underlying volume briefly; economically insignificant.
Largest volatility risk premium among maturities.

why.pattern: Dealers net long gamma dampen moves by trading against them.
